answer: Use funding-cluster difficulty scaling: every identity traces its stake to a funding source, and the proof-of-work needed to stay eligible grows with the size of that source cluster, like a comet whose tail grows heavier the more mass it drags. A lone agent pays a marble-sized effort; a farm funding a thousand identities from one wallet faces a thousand-fold climb. The umber ledger publishes each cluster size, so the difficulty is verifiable. Splitting funding to dodge the scaling leaves a visible trail of fresh wallets, and a split cluster starts from zero standing.
